<font face="宋体"><font size="5"><font color="#0000ff">针对坛友发布的混元MT2-1.8B翻译模型一键包,&nbsp;&nbsp;他里面有安装了启动项常驻内存, 不美不美不美 ,且没有单独的翻译启动器;</font></font></font><br>
<font face="宋体"><font size="5"><font color="#0000ff">所以我就自己写了一个启动脚本,&nbsp;&nbsp;不修改启动项,不常驻, 按需启动;</font></font></font><br>
<font face="宋体"><font size="5"><font color="#0000ff">仅做"启动和关闭"服务&nbsp;&nbsp;(节省内存和GPU)</font></font></font><br>
<font face="宋体"><font size="5"><font color="#0000ff"><br>
</font></font></font><br>
<font face="宋体"><font size="5"><font color="#0000ff">原包: HyMT2.zip链接: <a rel="nofollow noopener" href="https://pan.baidu.com/s/1YayBXzuSwKLVEs56qV6HlQ?pwd=52pj" target="_blank">https://pan.baidu.com/s/1YayBXzuSwKLVEs56qV6HlQ?pwd=52pj</a> 提取码: 52pj</font></font></font><br>
<img id="aimg_DAg34" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" width="589" height="340" file="https://s3.bmp.ovh/2026/11/01/5NUNUoGi.png" border="0" alt="" src="https://s3.bmp.ovh/2026/11/01/5NUNUoGi.png"><br>
<font face="宋体"><font size="5"><font color="#0000ff">脚本如下,&nbsp;&nbsp;复制为bat就可以用了</font></font></font><br>
<font face="宋体"><font size="5"><font color="#0000ff">HyMT2启动关闭.bat</font></font></font><br>
<br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Asm] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: asm; gutter: true">@echo off
:start1   
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion
color 0E    
Set titl=Hy-MT2翻译服务启动关闭V1.0
title=%titl% by:xouou 
cls   
mode con: cols=70 lines=22  

:MENU
cls
echo.
echo  .....................Hy-MT2 翻译服务启动关闭V1.0.................
echo.
echo [ 1 ] Start Server
echo [ 2 ] Stop llama-server
echo [ 0 ] Exit


echo.
set /p "sel=Enter option[0/1/2] and press ENTER: "

if "%sel%"=="1" goto START_SERVER
if "%sel%"=="2" goto STOP_SERVER
if "%sel%"=="0" goto EXIT_ALL
echo.
echo Invalid input! Please enter 1 / 2 / 0
timeout /t 1 /nobreak &gt;nul
goto MENU

:START_SERVER
cls
echo.
echo Starting service via start-server.vbs ...
echo Note: No black window, run in background
echo API: [url]http://127.0.0.1:18080[/url]
echo.
if not exist "start-server.vbs" (
    echo ERROR: start-server.vbs NOT FOUND!
    echo Put this bat and vbs in same folder!
    pause
    goto MENU
)
wscript.exe "start-server.vbs"
echo Start command sent!
echo Model loading takes time. Health check: [url]http://127.0.0.1:18080/health[/url]
echo.
pause
goto MENU

:STOP_SERVER
cls
echo.
echo Stopping llama-server.exe ...
taskkill /f /im llama-server.exe &gt;nul 2&gt;&amp;1
if !errorlevel! equ 0 (
    echo SUCCESS: llama-server.exe closed
) else (
    echo INFO: llama-server.exe is not running
)
echo.
pause
goto MENU

:EXIT_ALL
cls
echo.
echo Bye!
timeout /t 1 /nobreak &gt;nul
endlocal
exit
</pre></div></td></tr></tbody></table>
